events.title: IMA: Platform 2026 — Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie & Seren Wagstaff
events.datetime: Tue 30 Jun – Sun 5 Jul, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM daily
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: An annual exhibition at the IMA showcasing ambitious new works by three Queensland emerging artists, Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff, exploring themes of cultural heritage, material processes, and contemporary subcultures.

events.title: IMA: Platform 2026 — Artist Talks
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: The three emerging artists featured in the IMA's Platform 2026 exhibition — Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff — will speak about their ambitious new works and creative processes.

events.title: From the Jam — "The Greatest Hits Tour"
events.description: A live performance by post-punk/mod revival act From the Jam, playing hits from The Jam's iconic catalogue at The Triffid.

events.title: Triffid Sundays — Holy Smokes & Friends
events.description: A recurring Sunday afternoon live music series featuring Holy Smokes & Friends in The Triffid's beer garden, offering an intimate and social setting for local and emerging acts.

events.title: Mumbles the Dopes @ Ventspace
events.description: Mumbles the Dopes perform at Ventspace, an intimate outdoor/alternative venue in South Brisbane known for its indie and alternative music programming.

events.title: Denis Sulta @ The Prince Consort Hotel
events.location: The Prince Consort Hotel, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Scottish electronic/techno DJ Denis Sulta brings his dynamic and textured sets to The Prince Consort Hotel for a credible underground electronic music night.

events.title: FEID (Ferxxo) — Falxo Tour: El Mano a Mano
events.description: A major Latin urban music event featuring FEID (Ferxxo) and Falxo Tour: El Mano a Mano, performing at Brisbane's largest dedicated music hall.

events.title: Lifeline Brisbane Bookfest
events.datetime: Mon 29 Jun – Sun 5 Jul, 7:30 AM – 6:00 PM daily
events.location: Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre, South Brisbane
events.description: The final days of Brisbane's massive Lifeline Bookfest, offering a treasure hunt for book lovers with a vast selection of fiction, non-fiction, comics, and media, plus chill-out spaces and a game zone.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.description: A major international exhibition by Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson at QAGOMA, inviting visitors into an expansive, immersive experience through large-scale environments.

events.title: Open Season — Winter Music Festival
events.datetime: Ongoing through July (multiple events this week)
events.description: Brisbane's cultural program, Open Season, continues its sixth edition, featuring over 100 artists including jazz, hip-hop, R&B, and post-rock acts across iconic venues like The Tivoli and Princess Theatre.

events.title: Brisbane Improv Festival 2026 — Backstory Factory Workshop
events.description: A hands-on improv and creative storytelling workshop, part of the Brisbane Improv Festival, designed to help participants build narratives and connect with other curious, creative individuals.

events.title: Build with AI 4.0 — GDG Brisbane
events.description: A hands-on tech event organised by Google Developer Group Brisbane, focusing on building with AI tools and attracting curious developers, designers, and technologists.

events.title: Palace Cinemas — HSBC Spanish & Latin American Film Festival
events.location: Palace James St & Palace Barracks, Brisbane
events.description: The 29th HSBC Spanish & Latin American Film Festival presents a carefully selected lineup of over thirty art-house films from Spain, Colombia, Argentina, and more, offering an alternative to mainstream cinema.

events.title: Palace Cinemas — Classic & Cult Cinema Weekly Screening
events.location: Palace James St or Palace Barracks, Brisbane
events.description: A curated weekly screening series of hand-picked classic and cult films, presented with a complimentary cocktail or mocktail, perfect for cinephiles seeking repertory cinema.

events.title: Palace Cinemas — Marilyn Monroe 100th Birthday Film Program
events.location: Palace James St or Palace Barracks, Brisbane
events.description: A thoughtfully curated film program celebrating Marilyn Monroe's 100th birthday, showcasing ten of her most memorable performances for classic film fans.

events.title: Black Bear Lodge — Live Music & DJs
events.datetime: Various nights this week, including Sat 4 Jul
events.description: Black Bear Lodge, a stylish candlelit venue, hosts live performances from local and international acts, alongside regular vinyl DJ sets, offering an intimate atmosphere for music lovers.

events.title: Echoes from the Cave — Poetry Open Mic
events.description: A recurring poetry open mic night held on the first Tuesday of the month at The Cave Inn, providing a natural gathering spot for creative and literary-minded individuals to share and discover spoken word.

events.title: Captain Snips Collage Creations
events.description: A monthly creative collage workshop hosted by Captain Snips at Lost Souls/Netherworld, offering a hands-on opportunity for artistic expression and social interaction.
